beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Installing an update now shows a progress window titled Updating Work Sample Buddy, with the version being installed and a note that the app reopens on its own. Before, the install ran hidden for a minute or two and looked like the app had disappeared.
• After an update finishes, Work Sample Buddy brings its window to the front instead of opening behind other windows.

Fixes:
• The Update Ready prompt now explains that the install shows progress for a minute or two and then reopens the app by itself.
• The updater can no longer restart the computer on its own, and it keeps an install log in the app's data folder for troubleshooting.

stable.notes:
Fixes:
• Fixed the sample verification window reporting "All fields verified" when the date box was still empty. An automatically read date was stamped on the sample and counted as checked without ever being shown, so it could be saved without anyone seeing it.
